date.as_written: śrīśāke saṃmvat (!) 1743 || saṃmvat (!) 1878 || nipālasaṃmvat (!) 941 mti hāgruna || sivarātri khunu

notes: Three eras are recorded: Śaka 1743, Vikrama 1878, and Nepāla 941 (all corresponding to 1821 CE, Phālguna kṛṣṇa caturdaśī / Śivarātri). The subsequent phrase '(unu) torako || robhagalyā maṃcce māhāryāpa' is obscure; '(unu) torako' possibly denotes a ṭola (quarter/residence).
